title: Man saved from cold water – level 2
paragraphs: An accident happened during the World Clipper Race, where competitors currently race to San Francisco from China.

A competitor was changing a sail when he fell over the side of his boat. The high winds swept him away from the ship. He fell into the ice-cold water. People on the ship looked for him. It took them about one and a half hour long.
The man was in shock and his body temperature was very low.
You can read the original story and watch the video in the Level 3 section.

words.d: large piece of strong cloth fixed onto a boat
